archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: Swiss Precision Industrial meets Analog Print Studio (Tactical Dark Slate Canvas + Warm Cream Thermal Paper)

design_direction.emotional_tone: Utilitarian authority, surgical barcode precision, high-efficiency print production flow with tactile craft feel
design_direction.vibe: A specialized barcode mastering suite used in modern fulfillment centers and boutique industrial brands. Crisp technical rules, high-legibility measurements, zero generic SaaS fluff.
design_direction.theme: Dark workspace (#0F1115 slate charcoal) with physical warm-white/cream paper canvas (#FBFBFA) and amber-orange production accent (#FF5722 / #E64A19)

fonts.heading: IBM Plex Sans, Outfit, sans-serif
fonts.mono_technical: IBM Plex Mono, JetBrains Mono, monospace

header.style: bg-[#16191F]/95 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#2A303C] px-4 flex items-center justify-between
components: Brand mark 'BARCODR / PRINT-STUDIO' with active status pill
Brand/Template switcher (Brand dropdown + Template dropdown + 'New Template')
Google Sheets Sync Status indicator with live row counter
Fast Actions: [Undo/Redo], [Canvas Zoom 50%-200%], [Sheet Preview / Batch Print Modal CTA]

left_dock.title: Assets & Variables Dock
add_elements_panel: Dynamic Text (Single Line, Auto-wrap Paragraph, Price tag, SKU label)
Shapes & Dividers (Solid rule, dashed cutline, rounded frame, badge pill)
Brand Imagery (Logo upload, custom URL, product thumbnail)
sheets_sync_panel: Google Sheet Shareable URL input or Quick CSV paste
Public Google Sheet CSV Export parser
Sheet tab selection (for multi-sheet workbooks with multiple brands)
Draggable or click-to-bind chips into currently selected element

center_canvas.title: Interactive Print Bed / Stage
features: True-to-Scale Label Bed in mm and inches (e.g., 4x6 inch thermal, 3x2 inch retail, 2x1 inch shelf tag, 100x50mm EU standard, custom size)
Subtle millimetric ruler guides along top and left
Visual Snap-to-center and snap-to-edge guideline highlights (Cyan #06B6D4)
Interactive bounding box for drag/drop, resize handles, rotation, and multi-selection
Live Mustache interpolation preview (toggle between 'Raw {{tags}}' and 'Row #1 Live Data')
Thermal or color paper simulation toggle (Direct Thermal monochrome vs White Gloss with brand color)

right_inspector.title: Element Property Inspector
sections: Physical Coordinates: X, Y, W, H (in mm or px)
Data Binding: Static text vs Bound Google Sheet Column
Barcode Symbology Settings: Code 128, EAN-13, QR Code (Error correction level L/M/Q/H)
Typography: Font family, font weight, size in pt, alignment, uppercase transform
Appearance: Border stroke, corner radius, rotation (0, 90, 180, 270 deg), fill color, text color
Layer Order: Send Backward / Bring to Front / Lock Element / Delete

bottom_production_strip.style: bg-[#16191F] border-t border-[#2A303C] px-4 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-muted-foreground
elements: Current Label Dimension info (e.g., '101.6 x 152.4 mm · 300 DPI preview')
Selected Row Scroller: '< Row 1 of 128 >' with active brand indicator
Batch Status: '24 rows selected ready for sheet layout'

batch_print_modal.title: Batch Print Studio & Imposition Engine
capabilities: Target Sheet Type: Continuous Roll (1 label/page for Zebra/Rollo thermal printers) vs Multi-up Sheet (A4 or US Letter 2x4, 3x8, 4x10 grid for Avery/standard desktop printers)
Label spacing: Horizontal & Vertical margins, gap between labels
Row selection table with filters, brand search, and 'Select All' / 'Select Range'
High-fidelity Print Preview matching browser @media print CSS output
Instant 'Browser Print' trigger with zero header/footer margin overrides and CSS page-break rules

interactive_rules.drag_and_drop: Support direct dragging on canvas, multi-step snapping guides, arrow key nudging (1px or 10px with Shift)
interactive_rules.data_binding: Selecting an element allows clicking a sheet column tag (e.g. {{sku}}) to insert into text or barcode value
print_sheet_modes: US Letter Grid (3x10 address labels - 30 per page)
Custom Sheet Grid (columns, rows, margins, spacing in mm)

testing_attributes.rule: Every button, input, tab, template selector, canvas element, and print trigger must have kebab-case data-testid attributes

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.clean_code: Use clean modern React 19 code in .tsx or .jsx according to existing project structure. The project already has TypeScript configured with tsconfig.app.json and components in src/components/ui.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.barcode_rendering: Implement pure SVG barcode generators (Code 128 / EAN / Code 39) and SVG QR code matrix generator or lightweight client-side generators so barcodes look razor-sharp at 300 DPI print output without blurry raster pixelation.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.print_styling: Add a dedicated print-optimized CSS section or @media print styling so when window.print() is called, only the print stage / sheets are rendered with exact physical dimensions and zero background clipping.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.state_persistence: Store templates and custom sheet datasets in localStorage so refreshed pages preserve custom user label designs, multiple brands, and customized layouts.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.visual_feel: Use high-contrast industrial dark canvas (#0F1115) with genuine cream paper sheets (#FDFDFC) with realistic drop shadows to deliver that high-end print production feeling.
